title: 第195章 天空岛智库
slug: 在须弥假装是一个学者
content_zh:
看着尼可微变的表情，王言继续道：“这枚地脉记忆结晶在我手上，我或许也能将里面的记忆提取出来，教令院虽然没有太多相关的技术，但很不巧，沙漠里有不少赤王留下的技术。”

阿如，镇灵机关…这些都是和灵魂记忆相关的。

王言微微停顿，继续道：“实在不行，我去找草神大人，她肯定可以提取出这里面的记

一时间破碎的金属四处飞溅，击打在远处的地面上，碰撞出阵阵火花，还有一些弹射到三名分身的身边，但是却又被青黑色的能量护罩给拦截下来，重新掉落在地面上。

更何况她还有更重要的事要去做，不应该被陆时遇给影响，乱了心智。

“婷婷，你是蒋晓蝶？”苏婉琪对林婷婷肯定是认识的，而蒋晓蝶她有印象，只不过影响不是太深刻。

原本他们看见萧铁走过来，还以为是路过的，所以没有理会，没想到居然直接走了过来。

“仇人？仇人应该算不上吧，我这些年倒是没有与谁有过深仇大恨，不过，有过节的人倒是很多，数不胜数。”郭钰想了想道。

王骗子还煞有介事的拿起放大镜，“仔仔细细”前前后后的鉴定起来，一边看一边嘴里还发啧啧的声音，好像在感叹什么。

年安急忙转身就看到站在房间里的男人风尘仆仆，眉眸间掩饰不住的倦意。

陆天雨说出这番话，其实心中并没有底。但老板离开前对他说的那番话，明显是希望他能够摆平这件事情。看来，“总监”这碗饭，并不是这么容易吃的。

云天扬却并没有犹豫，屈指一弹，已然是将对方的灵魂碎片还给了她。

“这个混蛋……”白狼望着自己再次被无视，忍不住咬的牙齿咯咯直响，努力压制住满腔的怒火，转过身坐直身体。

幽兰牧蹲在密林边缘的树干上，遥望城门口处巡逻的魔族军队进进出出，眉头都挤到了一起，显然青木城已被攻破，城内被魔族完全占领，想要进去并不容易，而且他还带着悠悠和两只宠物。

尉迟慕前往码头这一路都没有休息，青影有些烦躁，他知道王妃和纪闵之肯定要追上来的，但王爷这么赶路，他实在也没什么时间留下记号。

当然，这么明显的欺凌，连白司颜都看出来了，花宫岚和闻人海棠不见得看不出来，他们大抵是没打算多管闲事而已。

事后他听闻那本秘籍最终还是被人给偷走了，但他已经不在门派之内，这伤心事他也不欲再回忆，之后便开始漂泊江湖的生活。

见被发现，司马重偃也没有隐瞒，抬脚便迈了进来，本来他就不是专门为了来偷听墙角的，只是恰好撞上了这一幕而已。

强烈的危机感让朱姚从痛苦中清醒过來，看到直取胸口的凶狠一击，朱姚用尽全身力气，左手死死扣住了幽兰牧挥拳的手腕，危险一击被生生化解。

江凯男意味深长的看了他们几人一眼，而作为主角的路耀，却一直像个旁观者一样，完全没有在意。

看着不远处那一身耀眼红衣的人儿，隐尘只觉得自己的心被填的满满的，在梦妍姗走进的时候，就张开了手臂。

“你是故意支走他的。”青龙翼这条笨龙都能够看出梦妍姗的意图。

此时天生异象，有一些强大的生灵残魂出现，立刻就有几百人给吞进了肚子里面，面对这可怕的生物，人们同样失去理智，为了抢回宝物不要命的就冲过去送人头了。
content_en:
Seeing Nico's slightly changed expression, Wang Yan continued: "This earth vein memory crystal is in my hand. I may be able to extract the memory inside. Although the Teaching Academy does not have many related technologies, unfortunately, there are many technologies left by the Red King in the desert."

Aru, soul-suppressing mechanism...these are all related to soul memory.

Wang Yan paused slightly and continued: "If it really doesn't work, I'll go find Master Cao Shen. She will definitely be able to extract the records in it."

For a moment, the broken metal flew everywhere, hitting the ground in the distance, colliding with bursts of sparks, and some ejected to the three clones, but they were intercepted by the blue-black energy shield and fell to the ground again.

What's more, she has more important things to do, and she shouldn't be affected by Lu Shiyu and messed up her mind.

"Tingting, are you Jiang Xiaodie?"Su Wanqi must have known Lin Tingting, and Jiang Xiaodie was impressed by her, but the impact was not too profound.

Originally, when they saw Xiao Tie coming, they thought he was passing by, so they ignored him. Unexpectedly, they actually walked over directly.

"Enemy?Enemies shouldn't be considered enemies. I haven't had any deep enmity with anyone over the years. However, there are many people with whom I have had quarrels, too numerous to count."Guo Yu thought for a while and said.

Liar Wang picked up the magnifying glass in a serious manner and began to identify it "carefully". While looking at it, he made a clicking sound in his mouth, as if he was sighing.

Nian An hurriedly turned around and saw a man standing in the room covered in fatigue, with tiredness that could not be concealed in his brows and eyes.

When Lu Tianyu said these words, he actually had no confidence in his heart.But what the boss said to him before leaving was obviously hoping that he could settle the matter.It seems that the "director" is not so easy to eat.

Yun Tianyang did not hesitate, and with a flick of his finger, he returned the other party's soul fragments to her.

"This bastard..." Bai Lang looked at himself being ignored again, and couldn't help but grit his teeth. He tried hard to suppress the anger in his heart, turned around and sat up straight.

Youlan Mu squatted on a tree trunk at the edge of the dense forest, watching the demon troops patrolling at the city gate coming in and out. His brows were squeezed together. It was obvious that Aoki City had been breached and the city was completely occupied by the demons. It was not easy to get in, and he also brought Yoyo and two pets with him.

Yuchimu didn't rest all the way to the dock, and Qingying was a little irritated. He knew that the princess and Ji Minzhi would definitely catch up, but the prince was in such a hurry, and he really didn't have time to leave a mark.

Of course, even Bai Siyan could see such obvious bullying. Hua Gonglan and Wenren Haitang might not be able to see it either. They probably didn't intend to meddle in other people's business.

Afterwards, he heard that the secret book was eventually stolen, but he was no longer in the sect. He didn't want to remember this sad thing anymore, and he began to wander around the world.

Seeing that he was discovered, Sima Chongyan didn't hide anything and walked in. He didn't come specifically to eavesdrop on the corner, he just happened to bump into this scene.

The strong sense of crisis made Zhu Yao wake up from the pain. Seeing the fierce blow directly to the chest, Zhu Yao used all his strength to tightly grab Youlan Mu's fisting wrist with his left hand, and the dangerous blow was resolved.

Jiang Kainan glanced at them meaningfully, but Lu Yao, as the protagonist, had been acting like a bystander and didn't care at all.

Looking at the man in dazzling red clothes not far away, Yinchen felt that his heart was filled to the brim. When Meng Yanshan walked in, he opened his arms.

"You took him away on purpose."Qinglongyi, a stupid dragon, can see Meng Yanshan's intentions.

At this time, there was a natural phenomenon, and some powerful remnant souls of living beings appeared, and hundreds of people were immediately swallowed into their stomachs. Facing this terrible creature, people also lost their minds and rushed over to kill people in order to get back the treasures.
